question: Can two independent EIP-712 owner signatures bind a partial Pool withdrawal to all five payment terms, while real Uniswap v2 swaps the complete ETH withdrawal into a fixed token and sends the complete token output to the recipient atomically?
affected_rules: docs/integration/uniswap/specification.md: payment authorization, full delivery, atomic failure, replay and reentrancy
docs/integration/uniswap/design.md: PaymentTerms ABI and swap/rollback candidate
docs/design.md: Pool operationId and EIP-712 authorization
method: Deploy a fixed-version genuine Uniswap v2 Factory, Router02, WETH9, Pair, and a fixed-behavior demo ERC-20 on Anvil. Deploy a minimum Pool boundary implementing operation identity, owner ECDSA authorization, one-input one-change-output, accounting and ETH transfer, with cryptographic balance/range verification explicitly stubbed. Deploy payment adapter implementing separate EIP-712 payment authorization, condition validation, guarded ETH receipt, real Router swap, recipient balance difference, and success identity. Exercise success, each payment field mutation, operation mismatch, signature/domain mismatch, direct withdrawal, deadline edges, replay/copy, after-withdrawal swap failure, and reentrancy. Record before/after Pool input/change/accounting, adapter ETH, Pair reserves, recipient token, success flags, and logs where practical.
pass_criteria: Successful payment consumes exactly one Pool input, creates one owner change output, swaps exactly w ETH through Router02 and delivers exactly the returned output amount to recipient
Changing any of w, token, minAmountOut, recipient, deadline or operationId invalidates the signed payment
Changing the Pool withdrawal or detaching it from the adapter cannot withdraw value
Expired deadline and min output failure revert without changes to input, change, balances, Pair reserves, recipient balance, success flags, or event logs
Successful payment cannot execute again, copied signed call fails, and reentrant pay is rejected
Any failed item is marked unresolved or failed rather than assumed to pass
evidence_boundary: Stubbed cryptographic balance/range verification is only evidence for the call boundary and EVM transaction atomicity. It cannot prove confidential value conservation, proof-to-operation binding, soundness, or full Pool integration. Local Anvil does not establish Sepolia behavior.
